EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: EPF Certificate and paid Challans for financial year 2025-26 (April-2025 to March-2026).
ESI Registration Certificate and Certificate from ESI Deputy Director regarding successful payment of ESI for the year 2025-26.

Affidavit Signed before Notary, Stating that the Firm has not been blacklisted for violating the Norms of Labour Department (GoK) and the Firm has not been penalized by any Court for violating the Rules & Regulations of Labour Department (GoK) (Rs.100/- E-Stamp Paper).

Enclose a copy of GST Registration Certificate of agency / organization and the list of Services providing to Different departments in Government / Semi government offices with values for the year 2025-2026. Further enclose a copy of monthly GST returns and schedules of TDS deducted from different departments / offices along with GST paid Challans, matched against those TDS deducted by different departments / offices.
Professional Tax Registration Certificate & Clearance Certificate for the year 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26
Financial statement for the financial year 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 Attested by Chartered Accountant

The firm should have average annual turnover of Rs. 250.00 Lakhs per annum in any of the last three years i.e. FY. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 certify by the competitive authority (Annexure-II) (both UDIN no by Charted Account).
